name: model-card
description: Document a machine learning model in a structured, transparent format for stakeholders, reviewers, and future maintainers. Use when the user says "document this model", "write a model card", "model documentation", "how should I document my ML model", "bias and fairness report", "model transparency", "what does this model do", "model handoff", "production model documentation", or needs to communicate what a model does, how it was built, where it works, and where it fails.
